notes: Random .INI files of 0..13 lines: the six keys in mixed case, near-miss and comment keys, blank lines, spaces/tabs/CR/VT/FF around keys and values, hex and decimal numbers and junk, names up to 70 characters with high-bit characters; most cases also get DRIVER and DEVICE lines. 0xbc36a (fopen) logs its arguments and returns the stream or (8%) 0; 0x11580e (fgets) logs n and the stream, copies the next line into the buffer, returns 0 after the last one and can set the stream EOF flag; 0xbc421 (fclose) logs the stream. The string helpers and 0x103e5c run as originals (needs --flat-segments). The output record and the AIL error buffer are compared as RAM.
